name: Mark Delahunty
career_history: Global Account Director at BGO, 7/2025 to present; Senior Business Program Manager - Site Acquisition & Lease, EMEA Region. at Microsoft, 3/2020 to 7/2025; Program Manager at Ethos Engineering, 4/2014 to 3/2020; Electrical Supervisor at Dornan, 8/2013 to 3/2014; Owner at Platinum Electrical Services, 4/2010 to 8/2013; Elec supervisor at Mercury Engineering, 2000 to 2010

career.title: Senior Business Program Manager - Site Acquisition & Lease, EMEA Region.

biography: Mark Delahunty is currently at BGO, a private equity REIT under SunLife, with $90 billion in assets under management. Mark joined BGO a year ago, specifically in the private equity side. His role involves site selection and leasing. He is working towards a CDO role within the data center side of BGO. Mark established a front-door team and an end-to-end process, "Microsofting" BGO's approach to site vetting. BGO is currently going through pre-ICOM on a site in London and a large site in Germany, with Milan and Madrid sites further out. Mark attended Data Cloud this year, his first outside of Microsoft, and noted a significant presence of Microsoft (and ex-Microsoft) people. He plans to attend PTC and Data Cloud, limiting himself to two conferences a year. He found Kickstart in Amsterdam to be worthwhile but will not be attending Antibes this year. Mark shared insights on Val's move from Microsoft to QTS, believing it's a strategic move towards a PE operating partner role with Blackstone. Mark noted the current US market is a "bloodbath." He highlighted the rapid decision-making of Neo Clouds (e.g., CoreWeave) with 6-week deal closures from LOI to close, contrasting it with traditional hyperscaler timelines.

assessment.note: Ward Search's own judgement, not a researched fact.
